units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 3:19">Targ. Job III, 19</cite> <he>יֵיהַב</he> Ms. (ed. <he>יָהִיב</he>, ed. Wil. <he>יְהִיב</he>); a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>יְהִיב</he>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Numbers 3:9">Targ. Num. III, 9</cite>; a. fr.—Imperative <cite ref="E00023"><he>הַב</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 30:26">Targ. Gen. XXX, 26</cite>; a. fr.—Y. Ber. VIII, 11ᵇ bot., a. fr. <he>י׳ ליה מילא</he> gave him assurance of safety.
<cite ref="Yoma 2a">Ib.</cite> <he>יהב את פלגא</he> (read as:) <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nazir 5:3:4">Y. Naz. V, end, 54ᵇ</cite> <he>הב וכ׳</he> give thou half of it.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nazir 5:3:4">Ib.</cite> [read:] <he>אמר דיֵיבִין ליה יַהֲבוּ ליה ואכל</he> he ordered that they give him (to eat); they gave him, and he ate.

Kidd. 9ᵃ אי יהבינא לך וכ׳ (read: יַהֲבִינָהּ) if I give it to thee, wilt thou be betrothed unto me? Said she הָבָהּ מֵיהֲבָהּ give it; כל הבה מיהבה וכ׳ all such phrases as ‘give it’, mean nothing (do not mean assent to the proposal); a. v. fr.—נסב וי׳ (h. = נשא ונתן) to deal.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:6">Cant. R. to III, 6</cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 7:1:15">Y. Shebi. VII, 37ᶜ</cite> top; a. e.—
Lev. R. s. 19, v. infra.—2) to put, place.
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 16:33">Targ. Ex. XVI, 33</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 12:3:10">Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>אין אנן יַהֲבִין ליה נֵיהֲבֵיה וכ׳</he> if we put him (his coffin) anywhere, we must put him with R. &c.; a. fr.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 9:5">Targ. Is. IX, 5</cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 5:16">Targ. Ex. V, 16</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Kiddushin 7a">Kidd. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>משום דא׳ למחילה</he> because it (money or money’s worth) may be given away without consideration; v. <cite ref="N01384"><he>נָתַן</he></cite>.—[<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 19">Lev. R. s. 19</cite> … <he>תתיהב דיהבת וכ׳</he>, read: <he>תִּתְיַתַּב … דיַתְּבַת</he>, v. <cite ref="J00713"><he>יְתֵב</he> I</cite>.]
